description: Call queues - callers wait here in order until an agent is free to take them

agent_no_answer_status.description: Availability an agent is moved to once they have missed max_no_answer offers

agent_ring_timeout.description: In seconds, how long to ring an agent before progressing to the next agent available

agent_wrapup_time.description: Pre-defined wait period applied after an agent handles a customer call

agents.description: The agents in this queue and their tier

items.description: One agent's tier in this queue

id.description: The user who is the agent

level.description: Agents at lower levels are offered a caller first

position.description: Order within the level, and the tie-break every strategy falls back to

announce.description: Media played to waiting callers at a fixed interval

media.description: Media ID (or appropriate media URI) of the announcement

position.description: Speak the caller's position in the queue before the announcement

announcements.description: Overrides for the prompts the position announcement is made of; the announcement itself is set in announce

media.description: The prompts spoken around the caller's position; a prompt left out is the system prompt

in_the_queue.description: Media ID (or appropriate media URI) played after the caller's position

you_are_at_position.description: Media ID (or appropriate media URI) played before the caller's position

cid_prefix.description: Prefixed to the caller ID name shown to the agent, so they know which queue the call came from

enter_when_empty.description: Allows a caller to enter a queue and wait when no agents are available

exit_keys.description: DTMF keys that let a caller leave the queue and continue in the callflow; an empty string turns them off

greeting.description: Media ID (or appropriate media URI) of media played once as the caller enters the queue

max_queue_size.description: How many callers are allowed to wait on hold in the queue (0 for no limit)

max_wait_time.description: Seconds a caller may wait before the callflow continues on the timeout branch, 0 for no limit

max_wait_time_with_no_agent.description: Seconds a caller may wait while no agent could take them, 0 for no limit

max_wait_time_with_no_agent_time_reached.description: Seconds a caller must already have waited before max_wait_time_with_no_agent starts to apply

moh.description: Media ID (or appropriate media URI) of media to play while caller is on hold.

name.description: A friendly name for the queue

outbound_caller_id.description: Caller ID for agent legs to contacts outside the account

record.description: Record queue calls, through the account's own recording storage

ring_simultaneously.description: The number of agents to try in parallel when connecting a caller

skip_agents_with_external_calls.description: Do not offer callers to an agent who is on a call that did not come from a queue

strategy.description: How the queue picks which agent to offer a caller to

tier_rules.description: When higher tier levels are added to the set of agents a waiting caller may be offered to

apply.description: Add levels as the caller waits rather than offering every level at once

no_agent_no_wait.description: Skip the wait when the current levels hold no agent who could answer

wait_multiply_level.description: Multiply wait_seconds by the level, so each level waits longer than the last

wait_seconds.description: Seconds a caller waits before the next level is added

time_base_score.description: Whether a caller's age counts from when they entered the system or when they entered this queue, which decides their place after a transfer
